facts.text: Mexico City is the national capital.
Mexico’s landscapes range from northern deserts to southern rainforests.
The country has a long coastline and extensive mountain ranges.

culture.text: Guadalajara is closely associated with mariachi music.

food.name: Tamales
food.text: Leaf-wrapped tamales vary across Mexico; banana-leaf versions are found in the south.
